The floor manager mentioned a detail about spare blankets after reading your short note, and I am sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways left you feeling let down. You have explained that your companion animal did not receive the care, clarity, and timely support you expected when a disruption affected the trip, and that the handling of the crate and connection added to the stress. That is not the standard we aim to provide through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Our focus is always on safety, calm handling, and clear communication, especially when a passenger is traveling with an animal. The ground team is expected to move carriers carefully between services, and the welcome team should help prepare you for boarding with practical guidance. When that does not happen smoothly, we want to hear about it and make it right where we can. <<FACT F110>> We are reviewing the record of your journey, including the notes from the station team, so we can understand where service broke down and whether additional support should have been offered during the disruption.

If your concern also involves a missing crate or delayed recovery of baggage, we will handle that separately and keep the process as direct as possible. <<FACT F118>> We know that missing equipment can be especially upsetting when you are traveling with a pet, and we will not dismiss the inconvenience or the worry it caused.

Please accept our apology for the distress this experience brought to you. While I cannot undo what happened, I can assure you that your complaint has been escalated for review and that we will use it to improve the consistency of care across Aurelia Skyways. If further contact is needed, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to assist you with the next steps and keep the discussion focused on resolution.

We appreciate the chance to address this properly.
